item.title: Where Is Dr. King Living Today?
item.description: At the start of every year, we celebrate the life and achievements of Dr Martin Luther King Jr. Although his life on Earth ended in 1968, his words and deeds inspired many people to carry on his life’s work right up to this very day. item.title: 2025’s Best in Genre Fiction
item.description: This January, librarians from across the country met to debate the best books published in 2025 for adults.
